claims.sentence: You qualify for accelerated study on an individual plan if you are enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program and you have secondary vocational, higher, or additional education, or you have studied or were studied in such programs, or you have abilities and development level that allow you to complete the program in a shorter time than the standard duration set by the University and federal standards
The University makes the decision to carry out accelerated study for you

You qualify for accelerated study on an individual plan if you are enrolled in an aspirantura program and you hold a diploma from aspirantura or adjuncture, a Candidate of Sciences diploma, a Doctor of Sciences diploma, or you are currently studying in another aspirantura program, or you have abilities and development level that allow you to complete the program in a shorter time than the standard duration set by the University and the educational standard
The University makes the decision to carry out accelerated study for you
The evidence does not state a fixed number of semesters, months, or percentage reduction for your degree
The reduction in duration is achieved through specific mechanisms rather than a predetermined shortened timeline

For bachelor’s and master’s programs, the duration is reduced by crediting results of individual disciplines or modules, and/or individual practices that you completed during secondary vocational, higher, or additional education
The reduction can also be achieved by increasing the pace of your program completion

For aspirantura programs, the duration is reduced by crediting, in the form of re-examination, fully or partially the results of individual disciplines or modules, and/or individual practices, and/or individual types of scientific research work
The reduction can also be achieved by increasing the pace of your program completion
Increasing the pace of your program completion requires a personal application from you
The University Attestation Commission makes a decision on your application
The University Director issues an order to implement the increased pace
This procedure applies only to students who have the corresponding abilities and development level
The evidence does not specify the exact length of the shortened program, the number of credits or semesters saved, or the minimum duration required
The evidence does not list the specific criteria or thresholds the Attestation Commission uses to evaluate your abilities and development level
The evidence does not state whether the University decision is final or subject to appeal
The evidence does not provide deadlines for submitting your personal application or for the Commission to review it
The evidence does not explain how the crediting of prior disciplines, modules, or practices is calculated or how it directly translates into time saved

If any course page or university portal states specific reduction periods, application deadlines, or evaluation criteria, those details are not covered by the provided regulation and should be verified separately. The regulation is silent on how the University calculates the exact shortened duration for individual students
The regulation does not define what constitutes "corresponding abilities and development level"
The regulation does not state whether the increased pace applies to all semesters or only specific periods
All gaps remain open as the evidence provides no further details
